baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُرْسَلُ, the dual عَلَيْكُمَا, the coordinated payloads, and فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ form one directed event.
baseline_models.mechanism: An external sender releases layered forces onto both addressees; the payload can arrive in successive units and closes access to prevailing aid.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies external release and makes the clause a directed deployment.
Succession in batches supplies a layered or wave-like delivery rather than requiring one instantaneous strike.
A smokeless blaze supplies the first penetrating component of the interdiction.
Copper metal supplies a materially dense second component while the smoke branch remains available.
Aid that makes one prevail is negated, so the deployment disables rescue as well as movement.

changed_reading.before: The ayah forecasts two harmful substances and says the pair cannot win.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a directed, layered interdiction whose arrival closes both passage and access to prevailing aid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ places two atmospheric or material nouns side by side.
baseline_models.mechanism: One inventory defines the blaze by absence of smoke and another defines nuhas as smoke without flame. Read together, they form complementary combustion channels; the copper reading remains a simultaneous material alternative rather than being resolved away.

activation_trace.role: Flame without smoke supplies one explicitly deficient half of a complementary pair.
Smoke without flame supplies the inverse half, completing an enveloping combustion merism.
Burning fire supplies the shared energetic field that holds the two inverse components together.
Copper or copper alloy preserves a coexisting metallic reading of the second payload.

changed_reading.before: The conjunction merely adds a second projectile to a flame.
changed_reading.after: The syntax can cover flame-without-smoke plus smoke-without-flame as an exhaustive pair, while also retaining flame plus copper as a distinct material reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive form تَنتَصِرَانِ is negated after a passive assault upon the dual addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing verb can deny not only victory or help but self-redress after an experienced wrong. The event therefore forecloses a retaliatory counterclaim, not merely tactical success.

activation_trace.role: Redress after oppression supplies the legal-social sense that is denied to the addressees.
External dispatch supplies the apparent injury against which redress might otherwise be sought.

changed_reading.before: They will be unable to defeat or ward off the attack.
changed_reading.after: They will also be unable to convert being struck into a successful claim of retaliation, vindication, or recovered standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَارٍ and نُحَاسٌ name the deployed media, while the final negation makes failed escape or resistance part of their function.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fire can brand and induce recoil, while nuhas can carry an inquiry or tracking image. The payload may therefore repel, expose, and leave a recoverable trace in addition to burning.

activation_trace.role: Fire-branding supplies a visible residue and gives the flame a marking function.
Flight, aversion, and lack of steadiness supply recoil as an effect of the sent medium.
Tracking news by inquiry supplies a trace-seeking function for the second medium.

changed_reading.before: The payload harms bodies at the point of impact.
changed_reading.after: The payload may operate as a repellent and tracer that forces recoil, marks the target, and prevents clean disappearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured order, a non-transgressing interface, attempted passage through cosmic sides, and an authorization condition turn the sent payload into enforcement of selective permeability. The boundary admits governed crossings but answers an unauthorized breach with layered interdiction.

activation_trace.role: Directed release supplies the enforcing response at the focus boundary.
A balance of justice supplies normative calibration, making the response part of ordered measure.
Transgressing a limit through aggression supplies the kind of boundary violation being prevented.
Clean passage to the far side supplies the operation attempted immediately before the focus event.
Sides and peripheral regions locate that attempted passage at the edges of the heavens and earth.
Power and jurisdiction supply the authorization condition that distinguishes permitted from blocked passage.

structural_cues: 55:20 lets two seas meet without transgressing their barrier; 55:33 then challenges the same dual audience to cross cosmic regions, and 55:35 answers the attempt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured order, non-transgression, passage, sides, and jurisdiction; I infer that 55:35 enforces selective permeability; alternatively it may be an eschatological assault that only follows, rather than administers, the boundary challenge.

changed_reading.before: An unconditioned punishment descends on two targets.
changed_reading.after: A calibrated boundary governor answers unauthorized penetration while leaving the surah's other governed crossings conceptually possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: For the jinn side of the dual address, the medium of genesis is reversed into the medium of interception: a hidden, flame-origin being encounters a smokeless blaze and a smoke-like complement. The human half need not be forced into a matching copper correspondence.

activation_trace.role: Smokeless blaze supplies the focus medium that can be turned back upon a flame-origin addressee.
Smoke without flame supplies an inverse fiery residue that also frustrates hiddenness.
Hidden jinn supplies the specifically concealed member of the addressed pair.
A restless flame of fire supplies the jinn's generative medium and enables its later reversal.
Burning fire explicitly ties that origin scene to the fire named in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 55:14-15 gives the two species different material origins; 55:33 addresses both species together before 55:35 sends the paired media upon them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden jinn and a fiery origin repeated in the focus; I infer an origin-to-obstacle reversal for the jinn; alternatively the repetition may only identify which audience is vulnerable, and no clean human-to-copper pairing is supplied.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is foreign ammunition aimed at both species alike.
changed_reading.after: At least for the jinn, an originating medium is turned into an intercepting limit, so the threat is a reversal of constitution rather than merely an external weapon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence announces pouring or emptying toward the dual pair, tests an open passage, places the test at a root whose inventory includes sides, droplets, and molten copper, then names copper in the focus. Nuhas can therefore be a poured medium that fills or seals the attempted corridor, not only a discrete missile.

activation_trace.role: Copper metal supplies the focus material that can occupy the attempted passage.
Release and dispatch supplies movement of that material onto the dual addressees.
Pouring while emptying a vessel supplies the sequence's preparatory material motion.
An open, unobstructed passage supplies the corridor that the focus medium can close.
Flowing droplets supply a distributed pouring mode across the cosmic sides.
Molten copper supplies the latent material bridge from the named regions to the focus nuhas.

structural_cues: Across 55:31, 55:33, and 55:35, the sequence moves from announced attention toward the pair, to a proposed corridor, to material sent down upon them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pouring, passage, q-t-r's spatial occurrence, its droplet and molten-copper branches, and focus copper; I infer a molten perimeter poured into the escape corridor; alternatively q-t-r may remain purely spatial and nuhas may arrive as separate projectiles or smoke.

changed_reading.before: Copper is one item hurled after a flame.
changed_reading.after: Copper can be the poured, distributed boundary medium that fills the very corridor through which escape was proposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge permits passage only with overpowering proof or authority. Because the focus dispatch root also carries messenger and message, the blaze-copper complex can function as the physically delivered counter-proof, with denied redress closing any reply.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supplies a communicative function for what is sent.
Denied self-redress supplies closure of the addressees' counterclaim after the message arrives.
An overpowering proof supplies the challenge's stated condition and the register in which the response can answer it.

structural_cues: 55:33 states the condition in direct address; after the refrain, 55:35 answers the same dual addressees with a passive dispatch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proof condition and a sent-message branch; I infer that the payload embodies the answering proof; alternatively 'sent' may be purely kinetic and sultan may mean power with no forensic exchange.

changed_reading.before: The response is only force opposing force.
changed_reading.after: The response can also be an authoritative rebuttal made physical: a counter-message that demonstrates the failed claim to passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate refrain places the boundary strike under the vocabulary of favors and denial. This can classify the interdiction as a severe benefit that preserves ordered limits, even while it remains punitive for the attempted crossers.

activation_trace.role: The sent interdiction supplies the event locally exposed to the refrain's evaluation.
Favors and blessings supplies the surprising evaluative category placed immediately after the threat.
Contradiction of truth supplies the charge that refusing this severe ordering act would constitute denial.

structural_cues: 55:36 repeats the dual refrain immediately after 55:35, without changing the two addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency between the threat and a favor-denial refrain; I infer local classification of the strike as protective order; alternatively the refrain may summarize divine acts globally and need not label each preceding event a benefit in isolation.

changed_reading.before: The event is only punitive damage inflicted on the pair.
changed_reading.after: The event can coexist as punishment for the crossers and a severe favor to the ordered system whose limits it preserves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scene opens the sky and renders it rose-red like oil. Fire plus copper can therefore be read not only as anti-personnel payloads but as precursors or participants in a red, fluid phase change of the very boundary being tested.

activation_trace.role: Burning fire supplies the heat field capable of participating in material transformation.
Copper metal supplies the red molten-material possibility in the focus payload.
Splitting and opening supplies failure of the tested sky boundary.
Rose color suffused with red supplies the transformed boundary's visible material register.
Oil or an applied oily substance supplies fluidity after the opening.

structural_cues: 55:37 follows the sent fire-copper complex and its refrain with the sky splitting and becoming rose-like oil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent heat, copper, opening, redness, and oil; I infer a shared phase-change sequence; alternatively 55:35 may target the fugitives while 55:37 independently describes a later cosmic transformation.

changed_reading.before: The payload affects only the two attempted crossers.
changed_reading.after: The payload can belong to a wider boundary phase change in which the sky opens and shifts into a red, fluid material state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory already permits branding, recoil, and tracking. The later recognition by a visible mark and bodily seizure turns those possibilities into a pipeline: repel the fugitives, expose or mark them, identify them from the trace, then capture them.

activation_trace.role: Branding by fire supplies a plausible visible residue on the intercepted target.
Tracking by inquiry supplies the trace-following stage of the mechanism.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies identification from a prior trace.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies the identifying evidence.
Seizure and captivity supplies the terminal action after identification.

structural_cues: 55:35 denies successful resistance after attempted flight; 55:41 later identifies offenders by marks and seizes them by bodily extremities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus branding and tracking branches plus later mark-based recognition and capture; I infer that the emitted media produce or expose the trace; alternatively the marks may preexist the focus event and the fire may only block escape.

changed_reading.before: The sent media simply burn or batter fugitives.
changed_reading.after: The sent media can initiate an identification-and-capture system by forcing recoil and making fugitives traceable or visibly marked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's repeated dual grammar and explicit pairing sharpen the internal flame-without-smoke/smoke-without-flame complement. The two payloads behave as a matched pair that closes opposite atmospheric possibilities around the two addressees, while copper remains a parallel material pairing.

activation_trace.role: Smokeless flame supplies one pole of the paired enclosure.
Flameless smoke supplies the inverse pole and closes the missing channel.
Copper supplies a coexisting dense-material partner to the blaze rather than being erased by the smoke reading.
A mate joined to its counterpart supplies the surah's explicit logic of complementary pairing.

structural_cues: The focus uses dual pronouns and two coordinated payloads within a surah structured by two risings, two settings, two seas, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pervasive duals and an explicit counterpart-pair branch; I infer exhaustive complementarity in the focus payloads; alternatively the conjunction may list two independent substances without meristic force.

changed_reading.before: Two unrelated substances happen to be sent upon two beings.
changed_reading.after: A matched two-channel payload answers a paired audience, closing complementary escape conditions without forcing smoke and copper into one exclusive sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because no rain is named in 55:35, but it remains anchored in the focus dispatch, drought-dust nuhas, and the negated n-s-r rain-relief branch; render it as an atmospheric reversal or anti-precipitation analogy, not as a claim that the ayah literally says rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A payload is sent down in possible batches, includes an atmospheric nuhas, and ends by negating a root that can itself denote helping rain.

activation_trace.role: Successive batches supply the repeated descent pattern needed for an anti-precipitation image.
Helping rain and relief by rain supplies the beneficial descent that the final negation withholds.
Drought dust and agitated dust supplies the dry atmospheric replacement for relief rain.
Abundant gushing water supplies the later life-giving flow against which the focus descent reads as a reversal.

changed_reading.before: A fiery volley falls and no help arrives.
changed_reading.after: The volley can be carried as anti-rain: descending batches replace the relief encoded in n-s-r with heat, dust, or hostile residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of s-ʾ-l to a slipping-out branch, so it is an activation rather than a translation of يَسْأَلُهُ; it remains valid because the focus itself carries recoil and tracking branches and directly answers an attempted passage. Downstream prose should label the covert-egress mechanism speculative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sent fire can induce flight, nuhas can track, and the final clause denies successful resistance after the explicit escape challenge.

activation_trace.role: Flight and recoil supplies the fugitive motion generated or blocked by the focus fire.
Tracking by inquiry supplies detection of an attempted covert exit.
The split-root image of slipping out supplies a stealth-egress possibility without replacing the source occurrence's ordinary asking sense.
An open passage supplies the channel through which slipping out would be attempted.

changed_reading.before: The pair attempts an overt breakthrough and is hit.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting exploratory model treats the payload as a repellent-tracer that also prevents undetected slipping through an apparently open channel.

strongest_changes: The internal branch contrast turns smokeless flame plus flameless smoke into an exhaustive combustion pair while preserving copper as a coexisting material reading.
The 55:31-35 sequence activates a poured molten perimeter: pouring, passage, q-t-r's sides/droplets/molten copper, and focus nuhas converge on a corridor-filling medium.
Earlier balance and non-transgression revise the event into enforcement of selective permeability rather than an arbitrary barrage.
Later mark-based recognition and capture strengthen the focus-only branding and tracking model.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became simultaneously spatial, material, forensic, and communicative: a boundary response can be poured copper or complementary flame/smoke, an embodied counter-proof, and a marking system. None of these readings requires suppressing the others.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether nuhas is smoke, copper, or intentionally sustains both readings cannot be settled by the packet.
The molten-perimeter model depends on treating q-t-r's non-occurring material branches as activators of its spatial occurrence rather than as its local lexical sense.
The packet does not supply a clean human-clay to copper correspondence, so the origin reversal is secure only for the jinn side.
The later marks may be caused or exposed by the focus payload, or they may preexist it.
The immediate favor refrain may classify 55:35 locally or may operate only as a global recurring frame.
